command:
from pathlib import Path
import json,sys,platform,os
sys.path.insert(0,sys.argv[1])
import codex_plugin_scanner
from codex_plugin_scanner.guard.native_runtime import native_runtime_status
status=native_runtime_status()
assert status.mode=='auto' and status.available and status.compatible,status.reason
assert status.identity and status.capabilities and status.manifest
assert status.capabilities.build_sha==sys.argv[2]
assert Path(codex_plugin_scanner.__file__).resolve()==Path(sys.argv[1])/'codex_plugin_scanner/__init__.py'
assert status.identity.path.resolve()==Path(sys.argv[1])/'codex_plugin_scanner/_native/hol-guard-runtime'
assert not any(name.lower()=='cigar' or name.lower().startswith('cigar.') for name in sys.modules)
assert not os.environ.get('HOL_GUARD_NATIVE_BINARY') and not os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH')
print(json.dumps({'mode':status.mode,'target':status.capabilities.target,'runtime_version':status.capabilities.runtime_version,'protocol_version':status.capabilities.protocol_version,'package_origin':'installed','artifact_sha256':status.identity.sha256,'artifact_size':status.identity.size,'build_sha':status.capabilities.build_sha,'rule_digest':status.capabilities.rule_digest,'platform_tag':status.manifest.platform_tag,'host_platform':sys.platform,'host_arch':platform.machine(),'python_version':platform.python_version(),'CIGAR_imported':False,'path_override':False,'installed_prefix_selected_by_bootstrap':True}))
